bio: It is as if the sun never sets over this characterful, whitewashed street corner building on the Instagram-perfect village square of Sint-Martens-Latem. As its name suggests, it is just the spot to feast on lashings of joyful Italian cuisine with friends and family. Vitello tonnato, al dente fettuccine with ragù and parmesan, house-made tiramisu: familiar family favourites that deliver the goods every time! The menu is comforting yet interesting and is backed up by a sensibly-priced list of well-curated Italian wines. An absolute treat....
